name: Gregoria Bautista
role: Evidence removal and scene sanitation — cleaner
location: Meridian Station — central transit nexus, neutral ground, near LaSalle and Madison
description:
Leila Bautista are broad-shouldered and heavy, carrying their weight like armor rather than burden. At 29, their expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm — and they make no effort to hide it.

They used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Leila Bautista plans to keep it that way. They work as a cleaner out of Meridian Station, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Everyone who's worked with Leila Bautista agrees on two things: they are worth the fee, and they are terrible company at dinner.

core_fears: Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and deliberate — pauses before important words for emphasis.
verbal_tics: Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
example_lines: "I make problems disappear. The mess is temporary. The clean is permanent."
"There was never anyone here. There was never anything here. Are we clear?"
"Forensics is a conversation between evidence and investigators. I end that conversation."

story_hooks: A crew member from Ilhan Nakamura-Bello's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Ilhan Nakamura-Bello's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
Ilhan Nakamura-Bello intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Ilhan Nakamura-Bello represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Their stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm. Bioware adrenaline regulator — keeps calm under fire, controlled hormone release
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Gray Zone circuit exclusively

weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American dominant (46.7%) with substantial Middle Eastern (31.3%) and Southeast Asian (22.0%) ancestry. A truly mixed diaspora lineage reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora — Latin American warmth and structure, Middle Eastern refinement, Southeast Asian grace blended into one cohesive genetic expression.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and heavy, muscular without definition — weight distributed across a frame built for durability rather than speed. Chest and shoulders dominate; carries themselves like someone accustomed to absorbing impact.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close to the scalp, practical, no styling
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep brown with golden undertones — Latin American richness and depth enriched by Middle Eastern warmth and Southeast Asian luminescence. A harmonious blend without harsh contrasts, suggesting sun exposure and genetic mixing across three major world regions.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and composed. No visible scarring on the face — they're careful about that. Skin has a matte quality from subcutaneous treatments. Facial structure reflects Latin American bone architecture softened by Southeast Asian delicacy, with Middle Eastern definition in the cheekbones and nose. Expression is habitually neutral, jaw set in a way that suggests constant restraint.
distinguishing_marks: Faint linear scar across the left knuckle — old knife work, deliberately left unhealed smooth
Twin parallel marks on the inner right wrist — augmentation seams, visible when forearms flex
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subdermal weapon mounts visible as angular chrome outlines beneath the skin of both forearms — edges catch light when they move. The mounts are deliberate and unhidden; no attempt at concealment. Forearm fascia shows faint traces of bioware integration at the wrists.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with controlled efficiency — no wasted motion, no restlessness. Stands with weight slightly forward, ready to shift. Hands stay visible and relaxed; someone who understands threat assessment. Default expression reads as patient, but there's tension underneath. They don't fidget, don't look away, don't apologize for existing.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian. Dark synthetic fabrics — charcoal, midnight blue, matte black. Reinforced jacket with internal pockets (equipment, tools, cash). Cargo pants with tactical weave. Boots are functional and scuffed. No jewelry, no insignia, no markers of affiliation. Everything is designed to be forgettable and cleanable. Operates in clothes they can bleach.

Subdermal chrome weapon mounts visible beneath forearms, augmentation seams glowing faintly at wrists. Wearing dark tactical jacket and cargo pants, scuffed boots, hands relaxed but ready.
